## About
Modern Mower is a repair shop on Mound Rd. in Sterling Heights. We work on lawn mowers, snow blowers and small engines for homeowners and commercial crews, and we'd rather repair a part than just replace it.
The owner, Brian Rismoen, is still the one at the bench as lead technician. He's been taking things apart and putting them back together since he was a kid, and everyone who works here has that same knack. Customers have written about Tim, Aaron and Jose by name.
We're rated 4.9 from 785 Google reviews, and we serve neighbors in Sterling Heights, Troy, Utica, Clinton Township, Warren, Madison Heights and Rochester Hills.

## Services
- Lawn mower repair: Tune ups, maintenance and repairs, done here at the shop. Just bring it in.
- Snow blower and small engine repair: Snow blowers and small engine service for your home equipment.
- Commercial equipment repair: We fix commercial equipment as well as residential.
- Blade sharpening all season long: Once we sharpen or replace your blade, bring the mower or just the blade back as often as you like all season and we'll sharpen it at no additional charge.
- Free winterization with a tune up: Had a tune up or maintenance package with us? Bring the machine back at the end of the season during the recommended time and we'll get it ready for storage at no cost.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on my brand?
A: We repair every brand made in 2004 or newer, including Craftsman, Toro, Yard Machines and the lesser known ones.

Q: How long does a repair take?
A: For common problems, maintenance and tune ups, we can often have it done in 1-3 days.

Q: Can you pick up my mower?
A: Yes. Pickup and delivery is $70 round trip within our service area. Call us with your address for a quote and a time.
